hypothesis: The zero-residual coefficient-8 mutations identified by the exact five-edge screen reduce the full frozen taxi violation count below the upstream seed's independently reproduced 5 violations, potentially reaching the target below 3.
rationale: The upstream seed's five failures are known exactly. The targeted screen found multiple coefficient-8 replacements that remove all five known failing edges, providing the strongest local signal available without full scoring. Because the screen can miss newly introduced violations, only the frozen all-edge evaluator can decide the hypothesis.
expected_information_gain: Determines whether the local edge repair signal transfers to the complete 7,000,602-edge taxi metric. A result below 3 would trigger immediate independent/adversarial verification; a result at or above 3 will close these top repairs under the tested neighborhood.
method: Read the two highest-ranked zero-residual mutated vectors from the preserved kserver-n7-targeted-mutation-001 artifact: coefficient index 8 replaced by -5 and -4, respectively. Load the exact pinned source and adapter and call its unmodified stage-D evaluator sequentially on each vector, using eight bounded streaming potential workers, the pinned circle_taxi_k4_m6 metric, and all edges. Stop at the first full result below 3 or after both finalists.
metric: exact full circle_taxi_k4_m6 violations_k for each finalist
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A completed full result with violations_k < 3 reaches the frozen finite target. Any result at 3 or above does not; the five-edge screen is not a substitute for the primary metric.

configuration.cache_architecture: streaming node potentials; no circle B cache

compute_budget.cpu: one parent plus eight bounded potential workers per sequential finalist

kill_condition: Stop at the first full result below 3, after both finalists, at 1800 seconds, or at a precise runtime failure. Do not infer target progress from screen residuals.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict target progress only if a finalist scores below 3

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: full score may be worse if new violations appear

repetition_justification: This is the exact full-metric gate for two finalists selected by a new edge-targeted repair hypothesis. It does not repeat the 700-candidate circle search, the one-worker taxi timeout, or the prior worker-pool configurations.
